Phase 49: legacy skill drift — impl submission (round 1). Implements the plan approved at bb2f433 (option B: detect and report, never delete).

What changed:
- tagteam/plugin.py: claude_config_dir() — $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when set and non-empty (expanduser + absolute, lexical, no symlink resolution, need not exist) else ~/.claude. legacy_handoff_skill_candidates(config_dir=None) — entries directly under <config>/skills named `handoff` or `handoff-*`, directories (symlink-to-dir counts) containing SKILL.md; returned as the absolute lexical <config>/skills/<name>, never realpath'd; sorted; read-only; [] on any OSError. render_legacy_skill_note() — "note: N user-level skill(s) under <config>/skills may conflict with the tagteam plugin's /tagteam:handoff:" + one path per line + "tagteam did not modify them. Review each; remove confirmed pre-plugin copies yourself." No shell command anywhere.
- tagteam/setup.py: main(..., report_user_skills=True) prints the note once after the plugin verdict (skipped under --no-plugin); run_setup passes it through; report_legacy_user_skills() helper.
- tagteam/cli.py upgrade: setup_main(project, report_user_skills=False) per project, one aggregate note after the loop.
- tagteam/server.py /api/start-phase: `/handoff-cycle {phase}` → f"{handoff_command(project_dir)} start {phase}" (+ " impl" for impl).
- tagteam/data/workflows.md: rewritten (219 → ~100 lines) to the 3.10 surface — roles, the three ways into the contract, the cycle and its one-call-per-turn table, the one-run rule, what runs by itself, steering, files written. No /handoff-* anywhere. No template variables (there were none before either).
- No hook change.

Tests: tests/test_plugin.py — TestClaudeConfigDir (unset / empty / set-nonexistent / relative + ~ → absolute / symlinked config dir not resolved), TestLegacySkillCandidates (none / no skills dir / several sorted / bare handoff / no-SKILL.md and plain-file ignored / my-handoff + handoffs ignored / symlink whose target is outside the config dir reported once by link path and the target never appears in the note / explicit config_dir arg / note shape incl. no `rm` token / empty note), TestShippedDocsAudit (no `/handoff-<cmd>` in tagteam/data/**/*.md or tagteam/**/*.py — a doc *filename* like docs/handoff-cycle-issues-….md is excluded by the regex; workflows.md names the current surface). tests/test_setup.py — TestLegacyUserSkillNote: setup reports once, lists both paths, says "did not modify", no `rm`, config dir byte-identical before/after; silent on a clean config; skipped under --no-plugin; report_user_skills=False; upgrade over THREE registered projects → the note appears exactly once, after the last per-project block, config dir byte-identical; upgrade silent on a clean config. tests/test_server_cockpit.py — TestStartPhaseCommand: migrated → /tagteam:handoff start P (and … impl); vendored → /handoff start P. tests/test_quickstart.py mock assertion updated for the new kwarg.

Verification: gate: see entry @ HEAD (on_submit run). Focused: plugin/setup/quickstart/docs_story/server_cockpit suites green before submitting. Manual: the arbiter's real ~/.claude was cleaned by hand earlier today, so `tagteam setup` against it is silent (expected); the note was exercised against fixture config dirs via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.

Round 2 — gate bounce on r1 was tests/test_roadmap.py::TestIdentityValidation::test_this_repo_roadmap_is_well_formed: my Phase 49 roadmap entry wrote `Depends on: Phase 48 (released 3.10.0)`, which the DAG parser cannot resolve. Now `Depends on: Phase 48`. Docs-only; everything in the round-1 submission stands — read that entry for the change list and tests.

Verification: gate: see entry @ HEAD (on_submit run); the roadmap test passes at HEAD.

GATE: PASS | scope 9 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1556 passed, 5 skipped, 4m54s)
checked: HEAD 008c2ed

One implementation blocker remains.

run_setup() returns immediately when needs_setup() is false, before report_legacy_user_skills() can run. quickstart_command() always enters through run_setup(), so an already-configured project prints only Framework files already present — skipping setup and never reports the user-level candidates. That contradicts the approved plan statement that setup and quickstart report once per invocation, and it misses the common case where quickstart is rerun on an existing project.

Make the run_setup early-return path emit the report exactly once when report_user_skills is true and no_plugin is false; retain the current single report through main() when setup work is needed. Add a focused test with framework_files already complete plus candidate user skills, asserting one note and no modification. A quickstart-level test is also acceptable if it covers that same already-complete path.

The gate record at 008c2ed is accepted (1556 passed, 5 skipped); no full-suite rerun was performed by the reviewer. The rest of the implementation review is clean.

Round 3 — the one blocker. run_setup()'s early-return path ("Framework files already present — skipping setup.") now calls report_legacy_user_skills() when report_user_skills is true and no_plugin is false, so an already-configured project (quickstart rerun) reports exactly once; the path through main() is unchanged (still one report). Tests (tests/test_setup.py::TestLegacyUserSkillNote): already-complete project + candidate user skills → one note, "did not modify", no `rm`, config dir byte-identical; already-complete + --no-plugin → silent; and the real quickstart_command() over an already-complete project (ensure_session/needs_init patched) → exactly one note, config dir byte-identical.

Verification: gate: see entry @ HEAD (on_submit run); tests/test_setup.py + tests/test_quickstart.py 72 passed at HEAD.

GATE: PASS | scope 9 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1559 passed, 5 skipped, 4m55s)
checked: HEAD 4e94d96

Approved. The Round 2 blocker is fixed: run_setup reports candidate user-level skills on the already-complete quickstart path exactly once, remains silent with --no-plugin, and preserves the config tree. Direct and quickstart regression tests cover the behavior. Gatekeeper passed at HEAD 4e94d96: 1559 passed, 5 skipped; scope and plan-doc checks also passed. The reviewer did not rerun the full suite.
